notesData.label: Tour price includes
notesData.content:
Round-trip flight tickets.
4-star standard hotel.
Meals as per itinerary.
Sightseeing transfer vehicle.
Enthusiastic, experienced English-speaking guide.
Travel insurance.

notesData.label: Tour price excludes
notesData.content:
Passport, visa fees (if applicable).
Personal expenses: phone, laundry, excess baggage, off-itinerary sightseeing.
Tips for local guide and driver.

notesData.label: Visa information
notesData.content:
Passport must be valid for over 6 months from the tour end date.
Please provide complete documents as requested by the Consulate to apply for a visa.

notesData.label: Children price notes
notesData.content:
Children under 2: 30% of tour price (sharing bed with adult).
Children from 2 to under 11: 75% of tour price (sharing bed with adult).
Children 11 and older: 100% of adult price.

notesData.label: Payment conditions
notesData.content:
Deposit 50% of the total tour value upon registration.
Pay the remaining amount 15 working days before departure.

notesData.label: Registration conditions
notesData.content:
Customers must fully complete the registration form.
Provide a clear copy of Passport/ID card.

notesData.label: Transfer or cancellation notes
notesData.content:
Transferring to another tour will incur a fee as regulated.
Tour cancellation must be notified in writing and incurs a cancellation fee.

notesData.label: Cancellation conditions for regular days
notesData.content:
Cancel before 30 days: loss of deposit.
Cancel 15-29 days: loss of 50% tour price.
Cancel 07-14 days: loss of 75% tour price.
Cancel within 06 days: loss of 100% tour price.

notesData.label: Cancellation conditions for holidays, Tet
notesData.content:
Cancel before 45 days: loss of deposit.
Cancel 30-44 days: loss of 75% tour price.
Cancel within 29 days: loss of 100% tour price.

notesData.label: Force majeure
notesData.content: In case of natural disasters, epidemics, strikes, flight cancellations... The company reserves the right to change the itinerary or cancel the tour and refund the customer after deducting the incurred service costs.
